# Phase Two — Tiferes Improved Plan

The Awtsmoos joins expansion with restraint in one harmonious line; Awtsmoos.com should reveal a stable domain first, then let richer renderers shine.

## Selected architecture
Use `apps/shared/movie` as the single canonical semantic project. Keep snapshots as canonical state. Add reversible patch journals for AI/human edits. App-specific renderers and editors become adapters around this domain. Existing proof Canvas runtime remains a deterministic Malchus fallback; Animator may provide the strongest spatial renderer without contaminating the core with app imports.

## Implementation waves
### Wave 1 — Domain truth
- protocol constants and factory
- richer semantic kinds
- version migration
- structured validation errors
- exhaustive validator
- public index cleanup

### Wave 2 — Surgical editing and AI
- patch kinds, patch applier, history
- provider interface
- director orchestration
- deterministic fallback planning
- continuity helpers

### Wave 3 — App and asset boundaries
- standard adapter base/result contract
- asset registry
- Animator/Nesher/Video Editor/Mitzvah adapter convergence
- duplicate Animator adapter becomes compatibility re-export rather than second truth

### Wave 4 — Experience and render contracts
- split mobile director dock
- renderer interface and quality profiles
- render manifest
- Canvas runtime expansion where useful

### Wave 5 — Tests and acceptance movie
- shared tests first
- adapter tests
- exact 180-second film
- browser and measured media proof

## Safety against impossible scope
Full production WebGPU physics, a collaboration backend, cloud render farms and professional audio DSP are architectural extension points in this pass rather than fabricated toy implementations. The task is still fully honored by creating truthful contracts, real current-engine functionality, app unification, AI revision, mobile UX and runtime proof now, while leaving advanced engines pluggable instead of faking completeness.
